```{python}
import geopandas, geodatasets
from libpysal.graph import Graph
from scipy import spatial
df = geopandas.read_file(geodatasets.get_path("geoda.groceries"))
```

```{python}
dflat = spatial.distance.pdist(df.geometry.get_coordinates())
```

```{python}
a = Graph.build_kernel(
    df.geometry.explode(), bandwidth='auto', kernel='bisquare'
)
k10 = Graph.build_kernel(
    df.geometry.explode(), k=len(df)//10, kernel='bisquare'
)
q20 = Graph.build_kernel(
    df.geometry.explode(), bandwidth=numpy.quantile(dflat, .2), kernel='bisquare'
)
```
